title: Chat Question Ability
description: The chat should be able to propose a multiple choice question with a fill in the blank `other` option. This can help them gather feedback before implementing

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed by teaching `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Chat.razor` to render a `questionCard` JSON envelope as an interactive choice card with an optional freeform `Other` response, then sending the selected answer back through the normal chat pipeline. The question-card contract was documented in `MemorySmith.Core/Docs/Prompts/wiki-chat-agent.md` and `wiki-chat-agent.modelfile`, and focused validation passed with the same 8/8 Razor/source-guard test run covering `ChatMarkup_SupportsQuestionCardsWithOtherResponses`.
